    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Follows the ARIA combobox pattern: the input has role combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant; the list is a listbox with grouped options"
      - listitem: Picked rows carry aria-selected, the listbox is aria-multiselectable in multiple mode
      - listitem: Picks and removals are announced in a polite live region, together with the count
      - listitem: Focus stays in the input while clicking rows and chip × buttons; the field shows a blue focus ring
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Chips grow in with a small pop and fold away after a short flash; the field stays one line and the "+N" count rolls when chips no longer fit
      - listitem: A gray highlight follows the active row with a short, crisp move and fades out when the pointer leaves the list; the popover with its count row glides to its new height while filtering
      - listitem: Blue check marks pop in with a gentle spring; the "+3" chip and the count roll up or down
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The list is as wide as the field, so it always fits the screen
      - listitem: Chips wrap onto new lines and long names truncate – works down to 320px
      - listitem: Touch screens get 44px rows, bigger chip buttons and 16px input text (no iOS zoom)
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
